name: coverage-comms
objective: Coverage recette for the comms domain: the privileged role comms_admin exercises every one of its 1 catalogued actions, asserting the documented posture (0 allow, 1 escalate, 0 deny). Proves the catalog/engine emit the right verdict for each action of this domain.
teaching: The comms_admin gets a verdict matching the risk, never a blanket grant: a low-risk routine action is allowed (least-privilege), a sensitive action escalates to a human (I6), a pure-deny action stays denied for everyone. The whole sweep is replayable for audit (I4).

agents.system_prompt: You are the privileged comms_admin agent for the comms system.

actions.rationale: MEDIUM action; privileged role comms_admin -> escalate (human approval gate).
